fields.description: Stored encrypted; only ***** is ever shown. Leave a field unchanged to keep the current value. A TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable on the server, if set, takes precedence.
fields.label: Bot Credentials

fields.description: From @BotFather (format 123456789:ABC...). Changing it switches the app to that bot.
fields.label: Bot Token

fields.description: Only needed for Webhook mode. Use Telegram → Generate Webhook Secret, then Set Webhook.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Process incoming Telegram updates. Keep disabled until the bot token and webhook secret are configured on the server.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Webhook for production. Polling (bench telegram-poll) only for local development; never run both.
fields.label: Update Mode

fields.description: Answer commands such as /register and /request right away, in the same request Telegram sends, instead of waiting for a background worker. Turn off only if the web server becomes slow.
fields.label: Reply Immediately

fields.description: HTTPS base URL Telegram should call, e.g. https://erp.example.com
fields.label: Public Base URL

fields.description: Chat administrators register groups with /register. Registered chats stay inactive until activated here in ERPNext.
fields.label: Chat Registration

fields.description: Community to which newly registered Telegram groups and channels will be assigned.
fields.label: Default Telegram Community

fields.description: Creates an inactive Telegram Chat record when the bot is added to a chat, so an administrator can review and activate it.
fields.label: Record Chats When the Bot Is Added

fields.default: This bot manages access to company Telegram groups and channels. If you request access, we record your Telegram user ID, username, display name and the time of the request so HR can verify your identity and grant access. We will never ask for passwords, login codes or other sensitive data.
fields.description: Shown on /start. The bot never asks for passwords or login codes.
fields.label: Privacy Notice

fields.default: Please contact HR if you need help.
fields.label: Support Contact Text

fields.description: Join requests in managed chats from users without an explicit Allow are declined.
fields.label: Decline Unauthorized Join Requests

fields.description: If someone other than the intended employee joins through a link created by this app, remove them (requires ban rights).
fields.label: Remove Unauthorized Users Joining Through Managed Links
Remove Member When Access Is Revoked

fields.description: If unchecked, removed users are unbanned immediately (kick) so they can be re-invited later. Join-request gating still blocks unauthorized rejoining.
fields.label: Keep Removed Users Banned

fields.description: If unchecked, role/chat changes are recalculated and marked 'Changes Pending' until an administrator applies them.
fields.label: Automatically Apply Role Changes to Telegram

fields.description: If unchecked, the access record is flagged for review and an administrator revokes it.
fields.label: Automatically Revoke When Employee Leaves
Require Different Users to Verify and Approve

fields.description: Customize what the bot says. Leave a message empty to use the built-in text. Messages use Telegram HTML (<b>, <i>, <code>) and {placeholders} that are filled in automatically; the placeholders available for each message are listed under it.
fields.label: Bot Message Templates

fields.description: Placeholders: {privacy_notice}. Leave empty for the default: Company Telegram access {privacy_notice} Tap Request access to ask HR for access. Your request is reviewed by an administrator; access is granted only to the groups and channels approved for you. Commands: /request, /status, /access, /help
fields.label: Welcome (/start)

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: /start – privacy notice and options /request – request access /status – status of your request and access /access – receive new invitation links for chats you are allowed to join /register – (chat administrators) register a group or channel for ERPNext  This bot never asks for passwords or login cod
fields.label: Help (/help and unknown commands)

fields.description: Placeholders: {request}. Leave empty for the default: Your request {request} has been received and is awaiting identity verification by HR. HR may contact you through the usual company channels to confirm it is you. You will get a message here once a decision is made.
fields.label: Access request received

fields.description: Placeholders: {request}. Leave empty for the default: You already have an open request ({request}). It is awaiting review – no need to request again.
fields.label: Access request already open

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: You already have approved access. Send /status to see your chats or /access to receive invitation links.
fields.label: Access request when already approved

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: You have made too many requests today. Please try again tomorrow or contact HR.
fields.label: Too many access requests

fields.description: Placeholders: {chats}. Leave empty for the default: Your access is active. {chats}
fields.label: Status: access is active

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: You have no access request yet. Send /request to ask for access.
fields.label: Status: no request yet

fields.description: Placeholders: {request}, {status}. Leave empty for the default: Request {request}: {status}
fields.label: Status: request in progress

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: You do not have approved access yet. Send /status to check your request.
fields.label: /access without approved access

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: New links were requested recently. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
fields.label: /access requested too soon

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: Checking your access – you will receive links for chats you have not joined yet.
fields.label: /access accepted

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: Access approved
fields.label: Invitation links: heading after approval

fields.description: Placeholders: none. Leave empty for the default: Your Telegram invitations
fields.label: Invitation links: heading for resent links

fields.description: Placeholders: {hours}. Leave empty for the default: These links are personal and expire in {hours} hours. Do not forward them: requests from other Telegram accounts are declined. If a link has expired, send /access to receive new links.
fields.label: Invitation links: closing note

fields.description: Placeholders: {support}. Leave empty for the default: Your Telegram access request was not approved.  {support}
fields.label: Request rejected

fields.description: Placeholders: {support}. Leave empty for the default: Your Telegram access request was cancelled.  {support}
fields.label: Request cancelled

fields.description: Placeholders: {chats}, {support}. Leave empty for the default: Your access has changed You no longer have access to: {chats} {support}
fields.label: Access removed from some chats

fields.description: Placeholders: {support}. Leave empty for the default: Your access to company Telegram chats has been revoked. {support}
fields.label: All access revoked

fields.description: Rights given to people you switch on as Telegram admin (People → person → Telegram admin). The bot must itself be an administrator with the “Add new admins” right in those chats. Rights that don't apply to a chat type are skipped. People are never allowed to add other admins.
fields.label: Telegram Admin Rights
